assets.pipeline: Built-in imagegen → local TRELLIS-2 → source-derived reduction/repair → exact-GLB visual and numerical QA

rendering.hardware: Local RTX A1000 6 GB; other existing user game tabs remained open
strategy: 32-metre chunks within 128 metres; at most 69 in the complete-world grid test, allocation 100
Two coalesced regional decode jobs, at most two chunk admissions or 3 ms per frame
Terrain instances and distance LODs; old exact-model foliage impostors and spatial placement queries
Shared texture bytes across LODs, unused regions and prepared meshes evicted after 12 seconds
Far static objects and actors culled; only nearby actor animation and fire lights update
60 FPS upper limit, shadows at 15 Hz, pixel ratio capped at 1.25
Snow, ash and sand use one fixed buffer of 384 shader-driven points
rendering.caveat: Observed samples are not a constant-60 FPS guarantee. Grassland at a region boundary with the map dialog open reached 43 FPS; settled snow, ice, volcano and desert samples reached 60 FPS. No sustained frame-time percentile benchmark is claimed.
fixes: Sky and mesh fog now use the same output colour space; distant silhouettes no longer appear as pale cutouts
The volcanic cone uses the accepted 13,382-triangle mesh for both placements; folded lower-detail revisions were rejected and preserved only in source history

movement.method: Stdin-only fixtures positioned the isolated QA players near each boundary; the real map UI then sent ordinary running targets and the server simulated continuous movement. Fixtures are not part of the web protocol.
movement.clips: Run_Loop, idle and free attacks observed
movement.heading: Rendering and authoritative server heading agree modulo 2π
movement.routes: All five destinations tested outward and return with a five-person crowd; every segment swept against actual colliders
movement.landmarks: Exact-delivery hash verified; rotated silhouette cells stop human and mammoth high-speed sweeps, leave traversable approaches and contract the camera

mobile.note: The attack intentionally stops the selected route. The after-attack frame is idle, not evidence of continuing movement.

cooking.test: Regional snow fire completes real inventory conversion and cancels a later cook without consumption after leaving its range
cooking.otherRegions: All six fire positions are shared by the server and client

limits: Finite 640 × 640 metre prototype; not an infinite world
Surface tile repetition and stylized source-derived details remain visible
Shelters and volcanic mountains have solid external collision; no interior exploration or mountain-climbing physics
